item.title: Improvements on the left need balanced on the right
item.description: After four painful defeats, Celtic steadied the ship with a late win over Aberdeen and a bizarre one over Livingston. We are entitled to recognise that as progress, however, despite the direction of travel, we should be prepared for anything to happen at Fir Park tonight. Wilfried Nancy will have learned lots from those wins, [...]

item.title: CONFIRMED: SCALES RETURNS, KENNY OUT
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY has brought back Liam Scales to his starting line-up against Motherwell at Fir Park this evening. At the same time, the Celtic boss has dropped misfiring Johnny Kenny with a frontline that looks like being led by Daizen Maeda. item.title: MOTHERWELL 2 CELTIC 0: X-CERTIFICATE CELTS
item.description: MOTHERWELL 2 CELTIC 0 WILFRIED NANCY stood dumbstruck on the sidelines as Celtic blew the chance to go joint top of the Premiership following an embarrassing display in an x-certificate performance against Motherwell at Fir Park tonight. item.title: PETER LAWWELL: PERSONAL VIEW BY ALEX GORDON
item.description: PETER LAWWELL officially ends a truly extraordinary 21-year association with Celtic today. Following an extended period of exceptional achievements – THIRTY-EIGHT trophies in 23 years – it should be a farewell accompanied with a glittering display of fireworks and a full orchestra. item.title: ‘WE’RE GOING TO GET BETTER,’ VOWS NANCY
item.description: UNDER-PRESSURE Wilfried Nancy watched in anguish as he suffered his fifth defeat in only seven games as Celtic toppled to a 2-0 loss to Motherwell at Fir Park last night. The champions were played off the park by opponents who dominated a first-half in which they claimed the opener through Ibrahim Said in the 13th [...]

item.title: ‘I BELIEVE YOU’RE LOOKING FOR ME?’ SIR ALEX AND THE CELTIC AUTHOR
item.description: SIR ALEX FERGUSON celebrates his 84th birthday today and CQN would like to add our congratulations to the Manchester United legend. The Scot’s achievements at Old Trafford have been simply phenomenal with THIRTY-EIGHT trophies including two Champions League triumphs and 13 Premier League titles. The Glaswegian has more than earned his place in Football’s Hall [...]

item.title: BIRTHDAY BHOY CCV’S DERBY WISH
item.description: CAMERON CARTER-VICKERS celebrates his 28th birthday today on the sidelines while Celtic endure turmoil on the pitch. The calm authority of the rock-like American international centre-back is sorely missed with the Hoops failing to keep a clean sheet since Wilfried Nancy took over seven games ago.
